findings: Accessibility / visibility of system state: status/index.html identifies the current lifecycle stage only through .stage-current background color and font weight. Both supplied screenshots show APPROVED highlighted, but the markup exposes the same sequence of stage names for every work order without identifying which is current. Add visible current-stage text and an accessible equivalent (for example, aria-current="step") so screen-reader users and users who cannot distinguish the highlight can identify progress.

Expand each link target to at least 44x44px.
